# Review


```{r}


saveRDS(ny_housing, "ny_housing.rds")


```


```{r}


ny_housing<-readRDS("ny_housing.rds")

```



```{r}



ny_housing |> glimpse()


```



```{r}



ny_housing |> summary()


```



```{r}


ny_housing |> 
    mutate_if(is.character, factor) |> 
    count(LOCALITY)



```



```{r}


ny_housing |> 
    select(FORMATTED_ADDRESS) |> 
    tail(20)



```


```{r}


ny_housing_2<-ny_housing |> 
    mutate(zip_cde=str_trunc(FORMATTED_ADDRESS,13,"left"))




```


```{r}


ny_housing_2 |> 
    select(zip_cde) |> 
    head(20)



```


```{r}



ny_housing_2<-ny_housing_2 |> 
    mutate(zip_cde=str_trim(zip_cde))



```



```{r}


ny_housing_2 |> 
    select(zip_cde) |> 
    head(20)


```


```{r}



ny_housing_2<-ny_housing_2 |> 
    mutate(zip_cde=str_trunc(zip_cde,11,"right"))



```

```{r}

ny_housing_2 |> 
    select(zip_cde) |> 
    head(20)


```


```{r}


saveRDS(ny_housing_2,"ny_housing_2.rds")


```



```{r}



ny_housing_2<-readRDS("ny_housing_2.rds")



```


```{r}



ny_housing_3<-ny_housing_2 |> 
    mutate(city=str_trunc(FORMATTED_ADDRESS,13,"left"))


```
